verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cloudflare Workers offers its own proprietary KV store ("globally distributed key-value" in cloudflare-docs-4, referenced by developers in cloudflare-comm-3/cloudflare-comm-10) and a separate Queues product (cloudflare-docs-9) for job-style workflows, but nowhere is there any mention of Redis protocol/RESP compatibility, a Redis-compatible API, or Redis client-library support. The story specifically asks for Redis compatibility, and the evidence pack only documents Cloudflare's own distinct KV/Queues APIs, not a Redis-compatible interface.
